ideas.name: Overheard
ideas.tagline: A shared feed of the funny, strange, and lovely things people overhear in public.
ideas.pitch: You catch a great one-liner on the train, tap it in, and it drops into a city-wide feed of anonymous overheard moments. Part comedy, part accidental poetry — a scrapbook of everything a place is quietly saying to itself.
ideas.reason: The moment it works, it's a privacy minefield. Half of "overheard" is really "someone said this and didn't know they were being recorded." We couldn't find a version that stayed charming instead of creepy — and "kind of surveillance-y" is a hard no for us.
